historical_reviews.deepseek: Matches the intended indicator broadly but unsafe generic commands and incomplete cleanup cannot prove all-drive coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact target mapping, secure command path, neighboring-bay observation and final all-clear state.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Present, Access/Busy, Fail and Rebuild use different triggers; this row alone owns commanded Locate/UID for all targets.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Each drive is an independent target and must finish cleared before proceeding to the next.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved Locate/UID command for every mapped NVMe SSD illuminates only the correct physical bay and can be cleared without storage errors.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts/maps each target, the agent asserts and clears only the vendor-approved stable selector, and command plus target/non-target physical evidence is captured per drive.
manual_activity: User approves all mappings and vendor syntax; qualified operator inserts and observes each SSD; agent performs one exact assert/readback/clear cycle per target.
required_inputs: Per-drive Locate/UID state, cadence, timing and clear specification
Pinned vendor CLI/BMC version and exact per-drive syntax
Supported insertion and data/RAID recovery procedure
Qualified operator, camera, secure credentials/OOB and failed-clear recovery
safety_requirements: Revalidate each target's stable physical mapping before command
Confirm indicator-only semantics and observe non-target bays
Preserve logs and clear one target before selecting another
Stop on wrong/multiple LEDs, ambiguous selector, failed clear, storage/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not use raw IPMI, guessed IDs or locate-all
agent_execution_scope: Capture per-drive baseline mapping and health
Record outputs/timestamps and final all-clear state with operator evidence
Do not handle hardware, claim visual proof, recover blindly or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mapping, tool, LED matrix and recovery
Provide operator and own wrong-target/failed-clear recovery
Review every drive independently and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Locate broadly matches purpose, but raw/generic command and unsafe access lack stable target selection, full all-drive evidence and verified clear.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a pinned documented interface with exact stable selectors for per-drive assert/readback/clear, synchronized with target and adjacent-bay photos.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All approved NVMe insertion, adapter selection, Locate checks and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute independent baseline/assert/clear transactions for every mapped SSD and prove no residual or cross-target indicator state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure identity and cleanup traceability without changing Locate scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation controls state; physical observation remains manual and per drive.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logical enclosure numbering may not match chassis labels and can change after service.

project_override_considerations: Only the project-approved SES, NVMe-MI, RAID CLI, Redfish or BMC interface may be used; interfaces and selectors are not interchangeable by assumption.
expected_evidence: Pinned tool/version and stable identity/slot mapping
Operator insertion and target/non-target photos per drive
Exact assert/readback/clear outputs, codes and timestamps
Complete controller/RAID/mount/NVMe health and OS/BMC logs
Final all-clear/restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently define all-NVMe Locate; broad HDD grouping and DeepSeek terminology do not change the literal target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, vendor command and operator are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe generic Locate suggestion into secure per-drive exact-target transactions with exclusivity and cleanup proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correct return code only confirms the controller accepted a selector; it does not prove the matching physical bay illuminated. Because stale or cross-target Locate state can misdirect service, every target requires physical exclusivity and explicit clearing before the next iteration.
